article.headline: Drexel secures 64-58 win against William & Mary
article.description: — Shane Blakeney and Kevon Vanderhorst scored 13 points each as Drexel beat William & Mary 64-58 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Drexel secures 64-58 win against William & Mary
article.story: PHILADELPHIA -- — Shane Blakeney and Kevon Vanderhorst scored 13 points each as Drexel beat William & Mary 64-58 on Saturday. Blakeney also contributed six rebounds and five assists for the Dragons (8-10, 2/3 Coastal Athletic Association). Vanderhorst was 6 of 12 from the field. Josh Reed went 4 of 8 from the field to finish with 11 points. Tunde Vahlberg Fasasi led the way for the Tribe (11-6, 2-3) with 10 points, six rebounds and two steals. Kyle Pulliam added 10 points for William & Mary. Reese Miller finished with nine points. Drexel went into the half leading William & Mary 37-28. Drexel used a 7-0 run in the second half to build an 11-point lead at 49-38 with 11:27 left in the half before finishing off the win. Up next These two teams both play Thursday. Drexel visits Monmouth and William & Mary hosts N.C. A&T. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
